name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Iran drones at Bahrain 15 Nov; 3 US carriers
summary: Iran fired drones at Bahrain on 13 and 15 Nov, condemned by the US; three US carrier groups are now in the region
state: Bahrain said its air defences defeated Iranian drone attacks on 13 and 15 Nov, and UKMTO reported a tanker struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 16 Nov (ABC News). US Secretary of State Marco Rubio condemned the Iranian strikes in a call with Bahrain's foreign minister on 16 Nov (Times of Israel). The USS Theodore Roosevelt entered the region on 15 Nov, joining two other carrier groups enforcing the blockade of Iranian ports. Active strikes between states keep the Alert.
for_you: Travellers to Bahrain, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Iran should check FCDO travel advice before and during travel. Gulf airspace and shipping can be disrupted at short notice.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states and attacks on shipping: Iranian drones at Bahrain 13 and 15 Nov; tanker hit 16 Nov

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
